properties.english_form: valid must never depend on ready. A sender must assert valid independently of whether the receiver signals ready.
properties.sva_form: // No combinational path from any channel's ready to its valid; checked structurally.

properties.english_form: There must be no combinational path from ready to valid or any of the control and data signals.
properties.sva_form: // Structural check on RTL: ready → valid combinational path must not exist.

properties.english_form: It is forbidden to interleave the beats of different messages on a channel.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) burst_in_progress(ch) |-> (current_msg_id == prev_msg_id));

properties.english_form: When a burst is in progress, control signals (opcode/param/size/source/address) must remain constant beat-to-beat.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) burst_in_progress(A) && a_valid |-> ({a_opcode, a_param, a_size, a_source, a_address} == $past({a_opcode, a_param, a_size, a_source, a_address})));

properties.english_form: Address must be aligned to size: (a_address & ((1 << a_size) - 1)) == 0.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) a_valid |-> ((a_address & ((1 << a_size) - 1)) == 0));

properties.english_form: For PutFullData, mask bits for all active byte lanes must be HIGH.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (a_valid && a_opcode==0) |-> all_active_mask_bits_high(a_mask, a_size, a_address));

properties.english_form: mask bits for all inactive byte lanes must be LOW (on channels A and B).
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (a_valid) |-> all_inactive_mask_bits_low(a_mask, a_size, a_address));

properties.english_form: While reset is asserted, valid signals must be LOW for at least 100 cycles.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) reset |-> (a_valid==0 && c_valid==0 && e_valid==0 && b_valid==0 && d_valid==0)); // plus min-duration check via counter

properties.english_form: Response on channel D must echo a_source: d_source == a_source of paired request.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (d_valid && d_ready) |-> ($past_value_of(a_source, paired_request) == d_source));

properties.english_form: Inflight a_source identifiers within channel A must be unique.
properties.sva_form: // Scoreboard-style check: at any cycle, set of inflight (a_source) values has no duplicates on channel A.

properties.english_form: The error field can only be raised HIGH a single time within a burst, and must remain HIGH for the rest of the burst.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (d_valid && d_ready && d_error && !burst_last_beat(D)) |=> (d_valid && d_error));

properties.english_form: Channels A < B < C < D < E in strict priority. Higher-priority messages must be able to bypass lower-priority ones.
properties.sva_form: // Topology-level invariant: enforced by separate per-channel queues + arbitration.

properties.english_form: A legal TileLink system must have a directed acyclic agent graph (DAG).
properties.sva_form: // Out-of-band proof obligation: enforced during architecture review, not RTL assertion.

properties.english_form: A response message always has higher priority than its initiating request message.
properties.sva_form: // Architecture invariant: enforced by channel priority A<B<C<D<E and request-response pairing.

properties.english_form: Timeouts that cause alternative messages to be generated are expressly forbidden inside the TileLink network.
properties.sva_form: // Implementation-review check: no timeout counter affects message generation within an agent.

properties.english_form: On Acquire (a_opcode=6), a_param must be from the Grow category: {NtoB, NtoT, BtoT}.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (a_valid && a_opcode==6) |-> (a_param inside {NtoB_code, NtoT_code, BtoT_code}));

properties.english_form: On Probe (b_opcode=6), b_param must be from the Cap category: {toN, toB, toT}.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (b_valid && b_opcode==6) |-> (b_param inside {toN_code, toB_code, toT_code}));

properties.english_form: On Release / ReleaseData (c_opcode=6/7), c_param must be from the Prune category: {TtoB, TtoN, BtoN}.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (c_valid && (c_opcode==6 || c_opcode==7)) |-> (c_param inside {TtoB_code, TtoN_code, BtoN_code}));

properties.english_form: On ProbeAck / ProbeAckData (c_opcode=4/5), c_param must be from the Shrink or Report category: {TtoB, TtoN, BtoN, TtoT, BtoB, NtoN}.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (c_valid && (c_opcode==4 || c_opcode==5)) |-> (c_param inside {TtoB, TtoN, BtoN, TtoT, BtoB, NtoN}));

properties.english_form: On Grant / GrantData (d_opcode=4/5), d_param must be from the Cap category: {toT, toB, toN}.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (d_valid && (d_opcode==4 || d_opcode==5)) |-> (d_param inside {toT_code, toB_code, toN_code}));

properties.english_form: On GrantAck (channel E), e_sink must match d_sink of the previously received Grant.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge clock) disable iff (reset) (e_valid && e_ready) |-> (e_sink == previously_received_d_sink_of_paired_grant));

properties.english_form: Master should not issue an Acquire if there is a pending Grant on the same block.
properties.sva_form: // Scoreboard: per block address, at most one outstanding Acquire without received Grant.

properties.english_form: Master should not issue a Release if there is a pending Grant on the block; nor further Releases / Acquires / ProbeAcks on the block until ReleaseAck arrives.
properties.sva_form: // Scoreboard: per block address, at most one outstanding Release without received ReleaseAck.
